package.name: ur3e_sysid
package.description: UR3e actuator system identification (Option B): an online sweep stage that excites one joint at a time (step/ramp via the trajectory action, chirp via forward_position_controller @60Hz) and records /joint_states, plus an offline estimator that fits the closed-loop surrogate gains (K, D), pure delay L, effective inertia and friction into ur3e_actuator_identified.yaml for Isaac. See docs/Robot_Control/ur3e_programme_identification_gains.md.
